title: Bank Setu
hero: Digital customer management for rural banking
description: Bank Setu brings customer records, passbook printing, PDF workflows and local-first synchronization together in one Windows and Android application for authorized teams.

features.title: Customer Management
features.text: Add, edit and search customer records in the authorized workspace.

features.title: Passbook Printing
features.text: Prepare customer passbook PDFs with the existing print workflow.

features.title: KYC & Status
features.text: Track KYC, passbook and account status in one place.

features.title: Documents & Photos
features.text: Handle customer PDFs and photos through the connected workspace.

features.title: Local-first Sync
features.text: Work with local records and sync through Google Sheets and Drive when available.

features.title: Backup & Restore
features.text: Create a local backup file and restore it through the app when needed.

screenshots.alt: Bank Setu mobile dashboard, identity details removed for privacy
screenshots.title: Dashboard

screenshots.title: Navigation

screenshots.title: Sync & Backup

downloadText: Choose the current published release for your device. Sign in with an authorized Bank Setu account after installing.
footer: Bank Setu is customer-workflow software for authorized CSP and rural banking teams. It is not an official bank service or endorsement.
